deploybot: PROD deploy started by @Priya R — environment=prod-usw2, commit=`3f7a9b2`, tag=`release-v4.1.0`, change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. kickoff_id=cb-4123
Priya R: Kicking off the cutover now. obs runbooks up, alerts on. @Sam (oncall) you up for post-cut checks? :eyes:
Sam (oncall): Yep, on it. I'll watch latency, error-rate, and queue depth. ping me if anything odd.
Miguel: Beginning canary -> 5% traffic. rolling update strategy = sequential pods.
deploybot: Canary applied to 5% (10 hosts). Health checks: OK. metrics snapshot: latency +1.8ms, errors +0.1%. Continuing monitor for 20m.
Ava S: Running quick webhook smoke: POST /webhook -> 200, sample message processed end-to-end. logs look clean.
deploybot: Canary healthy after 25m. Promoting to 50%. note: KV-cache warmup at 80% on new nodes.
Sam (oncall): Saw a brief tokengen latency spike during canary (peak +22%). No user-facing errors. keeping an eye.
Priya R: If latency spike persists or error-rate >0.5% we hold and rollback to `release-v4.0.8`. @Miguel prepare rollback steps and tag.
Miguel: Rollback plan staged (stop new pods, revert tag, drain traffic). `git rev-parse --short origin/release-v4.0.8` -> `a1c4d9e`. ready if needed.
deploybot: Promotion to 100% complete. final tag pinned: `release-v4.1.0` -> commit `3f7a9b2`. rolling restart of workers scheduled (parallelism=10). duration so far: 23m.
Ava S: Post-deploy smokes: webhook, embeddings, and rerank flows all passing. small increase in p95 but within SLA.
Sam (oncall): Spike subsided, metrics trending normal. no action required.
deploybot: Cutover finished. Status: SUCCESS. Duration: 24m 18s. checks passed: canary, smoke, metrics. pinned_tag=release-v4.1.0 commit=3f7a9b2. rollback_snapshot=a1c4d9e
Miguel: Release notes: draft posted -> https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/v4.1.0 (includes upgrade notes and perf results).
Priya R: :shipit: Great work everyone. Leaving notes in the handoff doc and tagging Product.
deploybot: Audit: deploy record cb-4123 logged to release-audit with latency and error metrics attached.
